newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico first half February CPI 0.89 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico first half February CPI 0.89 pct.

text.p: Mexico's consumer prices rose 0.89 percent during the first half of February after rising 2.57 percent in the full month of January, Banco de Mexico said on Monday.
The figure was in-line with expectations of a rise of 0.88 percent in a Reuters survey of Mexico-based economists.

It said the main causes of inflation during the first two weeks of the month were housing, car and home insurance, local telephone service, domestic gas, gasoline, medical services, restaurants, sugar and bananas.
It said the basic basket of consumer goods rose 0.88 percent during that time.
